limitations.cause: Batch validation compares every line against the same initial per-SKU availability without accumulating quantities.
limitations.trigger: With A stock of 10, a batch contains two lines resolving to A with quantities 6 and 6.
limitations.impact: Both lines pass validation and commit, leaving available inventory at -2. This material correctness observation requires Phase 1 routing through the root.
limitations.evidence: At 41c8c08a85e184017f6d0ea275abf2ad1622d776: allocation.py:19-26; api.py:27-28; catalog.py:9-11. The alias contract permits different product references to resolve to the same SKU.

limitations.cause: In-place replacement changes reservation quantity and stock but leaves the scheduled release quantity unchanged.
limitations.trigger: Reserve 4 units, replace with 5, then expire the reservation at its deadline.
limitations.impact: Expiry returns only the original 4 units, leaving available inventory at 9 instead of 10. Decreases can instead over-credit inventory. This material data-integrity observation requires Phase 1 routing through the root.
limitations.evidence: At 41c8c08a85e184017f6d0ea275abf2ad1622d776: allocation.py:35-43 updates only stock and reservations; repository.py:40-43 stores the original release quantity; expiry.py:7-13 reads and returns that stored quantity.

limitations.cause: Replacement checks the active flag without checking the reservation deadline or receiving the current timestamp.
limitations.trigger: A replacement request is dispatched at or after expires_at before the expiry worker processes that reservation.
limitations.impact: An expired reservation can still have its quantity adjusted, contrary to the supplied before-expiry requirement. Single-thread dispatch alone does not establish expiry-first ordering. Route this material observation to Phase 1 through the root.
limitations.evidence: At 41c8c08a85e184017f6d0ea275abf2ad1622d776: allocation.py:29-43; api.py:20-23; expiry.py:4-14. No expiry-first dispatch guarantee is included in the supplied requirements or README.md:3-4.
